name: v0.24.0
body:
## Highlights

- Temporarily marks Manipuri (`mni`, Meitei Mayek) translation as unsupported because current model deployments can return English or Latin transliteration while still reporting success.
- Excludes `mni` from `all` translation runs and supported-language discovery.
- Rejects explicit `mni` requests before provider checks or model calls across the CLI and public APIs.
- Preserves existing `translations/mni` output-directory handling, so prior files are not reclassified as source content.
- Updates English and localized language-table documentation to remove the unavailable translation link.

Manipuri support will be re-evaluated after future model updates and restored once Meitei Mayek script-quality checks pass reliably.

## Verification

- CI passed on Python 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14.
- CodeQL, CLA, requirements, and GitHub Pages artifact checks passed.
- Local test suite: 590 passed (excluding tests that require live API credentials).
- Documentation: 827 routes and 68,800 local article links validated.
- The 0.24.0 source distribution and wheel were built, installed in isolation, and confirmed to report version `0.24.0`.

## What's Changed

- Core: Mark Manipuri translation as temporarily unsupported by @skytin1004 in #583
- Build: Bump version to 0.24.0 by @skytin1004 in #584

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/compare/v0.23.3...v0.24.0
